flows.description:
Integrated Emergency Response for Drought-Affected People
Food Security

Flyktninghjelpen/NRC in Somalia provides a multi-sectoral lifesaving response with integrated services to address critical humanitarian needs, while contributing to increased self-reliance, resilience, and durable solutions for crisis-affected communities. The overall aim is to meet the essential needs of crisis-affected communities across Somalia. To ensure that the affected populations are at the centre of the response, NRC will actively collaborate with the local authorities, and affected communities and will continue to take a lead role in strengthening humanitarian coordination in Somalia to avoid duplication of efforts. Sectors include Education, Livelihoods and food security (LFS), Shelter and settlements, Water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH). The project design is informed by a gender analysis, and all indicators are disaggregated by sex.

flows.description: Multisectoral humanitarian response in Somalia	"Norwegian Church Aid Somalia’s programme addresses urgent WASH, food security, and climate resilience needs through a community-led, rights-based approach. It improves access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene, supports vulnerable households with food and livelihood assistance, and strengthens disaster preparedness. WASH services are designed and delivered to ensure accessibility and inclusion for persons with disabilities. The gender perspective is integrated in all of Norwegian Church Aid`s program work, with the aim to ensure safe and equitable access for all, and hygiene promotion activities will provide MHM kits or sanitary clothing for adolescent girls and women. The programme will be implemented together with the following national partners: KAALO Aid Development, Centre for Research and Integrated Development (CERID), Social-life and Agricultural Development Organization (SADO), Bani'Adam Relief and Development Organization (BANIADAM). "
